title: Models
subtitle: Every node and cluster in the fleet, the models each one can run, and manual start, stop and switch control.
disabled: Fleet model management is turned off in Settings. Targets and models are not collected while it is off.

routing.hint: Smart routing is a separate setting. Every control on this page works with it off.

routingPanel.title: Smart routing
routingPanel.never: Routing only sends requests to models that are already serving. It never starts, stops or switches a model, and every manual control on this page works the same with it on or off.
routingPanel.off: Smart routing is off. When it is on, OpenAI-compatible requests sent to the dashboard go to a node or cluster that is already serving the requested model.
routingPanel.baseUrlHelp: Point an OpenAI-compatible client at this URL. The proxy requires the dashboard's access token (SPARKDASH_TOKEN on the server), sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
routingPanel.noTokenWarning: No access token is set on the server, so clients calling this URL get 403 until SPARKDASH_TOKEN is set and the server is restarted. The route tester below still works because it only reads.
routingPanel.tableEmpty: No reachable node or cluster is serving a model right now.
routingPanel.resolvedTo: A request would go to {{target}} at {{endpoint}}.
routingPanel.tunnelNote: Models reachable only through an SSH tunnel are not routed.

token.banner: Model control is disabled until the dashboard has an access token. Set SPARKDASH_TOKEN on the server, then restart it. Inventory and logs stay available.
token.disabledReason: Disabled: model control needs a dashboard access token (SPARKDASH_TOKEN on the server).

errors.inventory: Could not load the model inventory: {{error}}
errors.busy: Another operation is already running on this target. Wait for it to finish, then try again. ({{error}})

targets.noClusters: No clusters yet. Use Clusters to define one.
targets.empty: No targets yet. Add a Spark or GPU host, then refresh.

detail.groupNote: This is a visual group: it has no inference endpoint of its own. Manage models on its member nodes.
detail.noDistributedControl: No launch profile is set for this cluster, so distributed start and stop are not available.
detail.busyElsewhere: An operation is running on this target (or one of its cluster members). Controls are locked until it finishes.

inventory.unreachable: The target is unreachable. No model state is shown as current until it answers again.
inventory.stale: This inventory is from the cache: the last refresh failed. States may be out of date.
inventory.refreshFailed: The last refresh failed. This inventory may be out of date.

models.empty: No models were discovered on this target.
models.clusterSub: Served by a cluster this node belongs to. Manage them on the cluster.
models.clusterRowStale: The cluster's inventory is out of date.

confirm.startBody: Start {{model}} on {{target}} and wait until it is serving.
confirm.stopBody: Stop {{model}} on {{target}}. Requests in flight to this model will fail.
confirm.reloadBody: Stop {{model}} on {{target}}, start it again and wait until it is serving.

switch.title: Switch model on {{target}}
switch.noCandidates: No model on this target can be switched to.
switch.exceeds: The estimate exceeds the target's memory.
switch.needsForce: Turn on Force to switch to a model that may not fit.
switch.forceHint: Switch even if the model may not fit or the current model has requests in flight.
switch.rollbackHint: If the new model does not become ready, try to restore the current one.

operation.title: {{action}} {{model}}
operation.cancelRefused: The operation could not be cancelled at this step.
operation.pollError: Lost contact with the operation; retrying. ({{error}})
operation.lost: The server no longer knows this operation (it may have restarted). Its outcome is unknown: check the inventory before trying again.
operation.authPaused: Updates paused: the server asked for an access token. Enter it, then press Retry.
operation.cancelConfirmBody: Cancel this operation? This stops waiting for readiness; an engine that has already started is not killed.

logs.none: This target has no log source for this model.

clusters.title: Clusters
clusters.deleteBody: Delete the cluster {{name}}? Its member nodes and their models are not changed. This cannot be undone.

field.name: Name
field.idHint: Optional. A slug is made from the name when this is empty.
field.kindDistributedHint: Members cooperate to serve one model at one endpoint. Its models are counted once, under the cluster.
field.kindGroupHint: Only groups the nodes visually. There is no shared inference endpoint.
field.head: Head node
field.hostHint: Empty uses the head node's LLM host.
field.launcherHint: Profile on the head that starts and stops the distributed runtime.

validation.name: Enter a name.
validation.members: Choose at least two member nodes.
validation.duplicateMembers: Each member can be listed only once.
validation.head: The head node must be one of the members.
validation.port: A distributed cluster needs a port from 1 to 65535.
